sourceText.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמַּפְשִׁיט בַּבְּהֵמָה וּבַחַיָּה, בַּטְּהוֹרָה וּבַטְּמֵאָה, בַּדַּקָּה וּבַגַּסָּה –

הַמַּרְגִּיל – כּוּלּוֹ חִבּוּר לַטּוּמְאָה, לִיטַּמֵּא וּלְטַמֵּא. עוֹר שֶׁעַל הַצַּוָּאר – רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן בֶּן נוּרִי אוֹמֵר: אֵינוֹ חִבּוּר, וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: חִבּוּר עַד שֶׁיַּפְשִׁיט אֶת כּוּלּוֹ.

positions.claim: flaying for a carpet, the hide remains connected until the measure of grasping is flayed; for a jug, until the breast is flayed; when flaying from the legs, the whole hide is connected until it is entirely removed
positions.basis: the manner of flaying intended for each use

positions.claim: the hide left over the neck is no longer a connection
it remains a connection until the entire hide is removed, the neck included
